horoscopes.horoscope: You are enthusiastic about mixing with people today, and you will feel like combining business and leisure. You will be encouraged to take part in group activities as you have the ability to work and have fun at the same time. Ganesha says that as a matter of fact you may emerge wiser from others’ ideas. Today’s the perfect day to ask your soulmate out for a romantic date. You tend to be hot-tempered while interacting with your loved one. You need to manage your anger. Otherwise, you may spoil the relationship. If you are already committed, you’ll spend a passionate time together. As you are full of energy today, you may end up taking impulsive decisions. Control your ‘fire’ and aggression so that your energy level is not depleted. Besides, avoid consuming spicy food as it can upset your stomach. Also, stay composed and balanced. You shall tend to indulge in speculation today, foresees Ganesha. You shall seriously think about pumping your spare funds into the stock market. If old investments have plateaued, you may think of off-loading them. You need to be very attentive and careful as you have to make some important decisions. Therefore, avoid being rash or impulsive today. Ganesha recommends that you maintain your cool. Even in the most difficult situation if you keep patience, half of the work will get done, says Ganesha.

This day you will be prone to be stubborn and uncompromising in your business and professional dealings and thereby inviting unnecessary problems. Ganesha urges you to guard against this tendency and conduct yourself cordially and amiably with your colleagues and clients. The day will turn out well for executives and administrators. Do not fret too much about the work in hand. Things will turn out fine. You’ll wear your heart on your sleeve today and will need your beloved for emotional support. You may not solve important matters related to the heart. However, things will get solved by the sweet help of your partner. So, stay attached, advise Ganesha. You will not face any major health issue today. Ganesha suggests you to avoid seeking emotional or moral support from others, as there are chances of disappointment. You should trust your own feelings and abilities in everything that you are dealing with. On the financial front, Ganesha predicts that things will just be so-so today. However, you shall not face any sort of financial constraint, and shall be comfortable on this front. A good day for those involved in the administrative work. Your strong leadership skills will help you guide your teammates. Beware of technical problems, warns Ganesha. Firm decision making regarding technical issues will result in an effective flow of works, says Ganesha.

You need to break free from the shackles of your daily routine. Trying to finish all your tasks as per your schedule will give rise to unnecessary worry. To manage your time creatively is the best way to beat the stress. Talking to your elders is a good way to calm your shot nerves, says Ganesha. Since you’ll be busy, you will try to please your beloved through a romantic email or SMS. Ganesha says that you should not feel shy of your beloved’s presence around you. Surprising your partner with a gift or party will be a clever idea. After all, these are the ways you can stimulate romance for your soul mate. You may face some issues while interacting with people in your professional and social circle. Yet, behave properly with everyone to maintain cordial relations with one and all. This will also have a positive impact on your health, says Ganesha. Ganesha says that today looks rather good on the financial front. However, you must not hanker after money, or you may be disappointed. Just carry on your routine work, and put money matters in the background. You will establish a strong association with famous and influential people from different groups. You may also find yourself busy in administrative activities such as documentation. Meeting with different people will enrich your knowledge and management skill, says Ganesha.

You will be involved in a team effort and associated with work like inspection and examination. You will base your opinions on your friends’ choices. So select good friends, says Ganesha. You will spend time with close circle. Your partner may easily believe in you. You should not dominate your beloved. He/she may not put up with you this time, says Ganesha. You need to understand the psyche of your partner as disagreement later will put you in trouble, says Ganesha. Be considerate and not stubborn, says Ganesha. You should look at things from the other angle, and try to understand people. Act prudently, and avoid disputes – it may spoil your mood and have a detrimental effect on your health. Planets indicate that today is a good day to invest money in fixed deposit or government schemes, because they are likely to give you better returns. Overall, the day is quite favourable for you. Today, you may plan to change your job, mostly because you believe that your pay is not at par with the amount of work you are putting in. You, however, will immediately get some sort of assurance from your colleagues.

Your decisions today will be not only be correct, but also resolute and steadfast. Your health will be fine. At the work-place, things ought to proceed as usual. However, you will concentrate more on work today. In personal relationships, some minor arguments could crop up. Take care not to let them blow up into major confrontations, says Ganesha. Lucky Colour Deep Bright Yellow Keep your ego in check if you want your personal life to be tolerable. If you need to get something valuable, you need to sacrifice something. You will always get support from your soul mate once you will be loyal and faithful to him/her. Certain events that occur today, may not be in your favour. Some people may try to find faults and critise you. Anyway, Ganesha suggests that you should not get upset. Instead, practice yoga and meditation for attaining peace of mind. When it comes to financial matters, Ganesha advisees you to be very careful at least of the big investments, and plan them out well to avoid untoward incidents. You may go ahead with minor expenses. This is the day to exhibit confidence and a lot of positive energy. Your good performance at work is likely to make your co-workers jealous. You need to be very careful of your words and actions. You are likely to get supports from your boss, says Ganesha.

An unusual dose of creativity will motivate you to make a trip to some exotic place and mingle with new people. You will have some experiences that will enrich you mentally and emotionally. But don’t unpack yet, there may be another adventure on the cards. Ganesha says you will be very flexible and adaptable today. Ganesha says that you may not be well prepared to please your sweetheart. Your effort to seduce your love interest will fail. If you think that you are the boss in the art of seduction, you are wrong. You need to learn it from your soul mate. Some health issues may spoil your mood and plans for the day. Those suffering from cervical pain, or spinal cord disorders should especially remain cautious to avoid complications. If required, you should immediately go for a medical checkup, advises Ganesha. Today’s planetary positions suggest that despite your efforts to save money, you may end up burning a hole in your pockets. You should not regret this as impulsive phase will pass. Today you may need to show your warrior spirit at the professional as well as the personal front. While trying to make a crucial decision, you may have to delay some important decisions. Due to this, your efforts may not be taken into consideration.

Ganesha says you will be getting good news from abroad, which will make you happy. Those of you who are searching for jobs will get good news coming your way. Ganesha says that you should not expect too much or you would feel dejected and disappointed when it is not met. Your beloved will cheer you up and will help you reinstate balance in your life. You will share some interesting thoughts to sweeten your relationship. Painting, singing or dancing will be your interest today. You are in a mood to spend a productive time with your partner, foresees Ganesha. Ganesha foresees that you shall be in the pink of health today. This will enable you to strike the right balance between your personal and professional life. Also make it a point to eat nutritious food and exercise regularly. Ganesha feels that today is a good day to start something new. In other words, you need to building another avenue to earn some extra money to strengthen your savings. Today, you are in a bit of a scramble, foresees Ganesha. You will have to deal with people from higher authority and will have to make sure that their egos are in good health. You should be confident to take the enormous pressure since this job will demand strong attention, the presence of mind, and dedication.

Today, you are like a balloon that may burst any time. You may vent out all the sweet and bitter experiences and feel much lighter. Or it may have adverse effects on your health, says Ganesha. You prefer to stay in your cocoon, in the warmth of your near and dear ones. You don’t need to bring professional matters once in the company of your beloved and spend quality time with him/her. You will need emotional support from your sweetheart in order to build a solid bond. Dancing or hot yoga with your beloved will create your mood to spice up, suggests Ganesha. With your mind full of novel ideas and your body brimfull with stamina, this is the right time to undertake tough activities on all the fronts of life. Your determination and dedication shall help to easily complete incomplete tasks. Today is an ideal time for switching from job to business to earn more money. Also, it is a good day to hop on to a better paying job. By and large, the day is good for taking financial decisions. Today, you will turn workaholic, feels Ganesha. You are focused and have no time to catch your breath as you are over-loaded with work responsibilities. Your aggressive approach will speed up the workflow. Meditation will help you feel good and do good, says Ganesha.

Determined and dedicated, that’s what you are when it comes to work. Well, this may even find you amidst heaps of files and loads of work. No wonder you become a workaholic. You are likely to enjoy during the latter half of the day. Have a fun-filled evening!. Travelling is on the cards, says Ganesha. This is a good time to make a trip to a far off place with your beloved. Sea beaches, jungle or hill station may attract you and you are in a mood to spend an amazingly intimate moment with your soul mate. Your oral and written communications skills will step to the fore. This will enable you to clearly convey your thoughts and leave a lasting impression on everyone in your home and office. Convincing difficult people will be easy, says Ganesha. Ganesha feels that today your zest to earn extra money will be so strong that you will not mind taking risks. Today is an auspicious day for money matters, provided your decisions are rational. Today, your luck will be as good as it can get. All the risks that you take will bring positive results. You may want to experiment with new software or may want to design something that you have had in mind for a long time. Your efforts will spread positivity in the office.

You firmly believe in the concept of ‘health is wealth’. You have maintained a very good health so far and it will not be an issue today, also. Successful completion of current projects seem to be a distant target, however, you will finish them off. Your boss may get upset with you for not completing the work on time. You will put monetary issues on the back burner for the day, says Ganesha. After a tiresome day at work, your partner will take good care of you and her/his mere presence will bring your energy and enthusiasm back. It’s a great time to get a soothing massage therapy from your sweetheart. It will rejuvenate your soul. Ganesha foresees that today your energy level is likely to move downwards. If it is not urgent, you should avoid doing tough tasks. In case, you are overloaded with work, the best thing is to seek help of people around you. Today is not a favourable day to set up joint accounts as it could lead to suspicions with your friends or near and dear ones. Ganesha cautions you to be careful regarding financial affairs. Technical problems at work will spoil the entire day. Ganesha says you may want to work out a contingency plan to sort out things at work. Managing the time and efficiency would be the challenges for you. Proper planning and strategies will keep you ahead in the competition.

You are close to you family, and now is the time to enjoy the company of your loved ones at home. You will take them out for shopping, go with them on picnics and pamper them in every possible way, says Ganesha. Not that you made them feel special with a selfish motive, but your show of affection will work wonders for you. Lucky Colour Light Electric Blue Today Ganesha feels that you will spend quality time with your beloved. You will enjoy your time, but Ganesha advisees you not to impose your views on your lover. Reading books together and listening to music will enliven your evening and entertain you. The mounting work pressure and rising heap of work files, may cause lots of anxiety today. But don’t get upset, and try your best to complete the tasks. Watch your health, and take short breaks to refresh yourself, advises Ganesha. Today is not a good day to invest in the realty market and you should wait for planetary to turn favourable. Your financial decisions may not be spot on, so tread carefully. Let your superiors and seniors take charge at the office. Avoid confrontation as your colleagues may not like it and speak ill of you behind your back. You should remain cool and keep maintaining good relations with everybody at work, suggests Ganesha.

Ganesha asks you not to undertake any new project or business venture due to the alignment of the planets being unfavorable. You will do well in tasks that do not require too much creativity and innovation. Do not take sides when you are not required to and it make have heavy consequences in future. Shun any bias and prejudice you may have in being selective in your work and be objective in deciding what is good for you, suggests Ganesha. You are likely to spend the time alone and ignore your beloved and this may cause strong repercussions. Your partner may doubt your motives and reactions. Avoid any quarrel and don’t allow any confusions in your mind. You should think for the future and strengthen the bond. On this dicey day, the less favourable conditions on all the fronts may test your patience. But, instead of getting disappointed – try to remain composed. Then, make all efforts to tackle tough tasks and handle difficult people, advises Ganesha. You shall be very rational on the financial front today. For once, you shall be using your head more than your heart while spending money, which is a very good thing, says Ganesha. You will remain focused and grounded in your work, foresees Ganesha. An important meeting may get delayed. You are likely to fix the problems but Ganesha says that you should try and finish your own work first. The deadline should be the top priority.
